title: Drop-D declaration flows into derivation
description: The part declares drop-D strings (string 6 = D2); four bare quarters sound D2 A2 D3 F#3. D2 derives to string 6 fret 0 — unreachable in standard tuning — and the rest fall out as (5,0) (4,0) (4,4). Proves the declared strings[] actually feed the derivation (the pre-stage-3 fallback hardcoded standard tuning and would have failed this scenario).
